question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Final query for submission
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT cs.race_id, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_race lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
),
best_driver_points AS (
    SELECT ds.race_id, tdr.constructor_id as best_driver_constructor_id, ds.points as driver_points, lr.year
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_race lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN team_driver_ranks tdr ON ds.driver_id = tdr.driver_id 
        AND lr.year = tdr.year
    WHERE CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR)::INTEGER = 1
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        csp.constructor_name,
        bdp.year,
        csp.constructor_points,
        bdp.driver_points,
        csp.constructor_points + bdp.driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
    JOIN best_driver_points bdp ON csp.race_id = bdp.race_id AND csp.constructor_id = bdp.best_driver_constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY combined_points DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
